interpretation: Cohort-normalized capacity-response stress tests for MIMIC-IV Phase 1. They are not estimates of observed staffing or reconstructed hospital shifts.
frontline_measure: nominal immediate alerts per 100 prescribing bundles; protected safety alerts may exceed this threshold and are reported as overruns
expert_measure: fraction of pre-capacity expert-review demand that can be served

scenarios.name: low_capacity
scenarios.description: Low-resource stress test: nominal frontline density 0.5 per 100 prescribing bundles and expert service for 25% of review demand.

scenarios.name: medium_capacity
scenarios.description: Middle stress-test point: nominal frontline density 1.0 per 100 prescribing bundles and expert service for 50% of review demand.

scenarios.name: high_capacity
scenarios.description: Higher-resource stress test: nominal frontline density 2.0 per 100 prescribing bundles and expert service for 75% of review demand.

scenarios.name: unconstrained_reference
scenarios.description: Reference condition preserving all pre-capacity resource actions; not a deployable staffing assumption.
